notes.title: Netsoccer 2.147
notes.content:
[b]Netsoccer 2.147[/b]

- Add New Game interface GUI
- Add Chat Notification and tabs
- You can now ask for the ball during goalkicks
- Add countdown to start challenges
- Add new logo and design
- Add player and team search filter
- Team Rankings Now Only Display Those Who Have Played Challenges
- Add training stats
- Add playing experience, and accumulating 100% wins vip
- Add in-game tutorials
- Add new type of uniform
- Uniform in-game bug fixed
- Flags bug fixed
- Updated game options with more information to modify
